You can use the Search bar on the [[New Tab page in Firefox|New Tab page]] or you can [[Search with the Firefox address bar|search the Web from the address bar]]. You can also customize Firefox to add a separate Search bar to your Firefox toolbar.

[[Image:add search bar 57]]

Follow these steps to add or remove a separate Search bar:
#Click the menu button [[Image:Fx89menuButton]], then click {menu More tools}.
#Select {menu Customize Toolbar…}
#;[[Image:FxMenu-MoreTools-CustomizeToolbar|width=300]]
#Drag the Search bar item into or out of the toolbar and then click {button Done}.
{note} '''Tip:''' If using the keyboard, you can use the {key Tab} and {key Shift+Tab} keys to focus the Search bar item, and then open the context menu to add or remove it from the toolbar.{/note}
[[Image:Search bar item]]

For more information, see [[Customize Firefox controls, buttons and toolbars]].
{note}'''Note:''' The separate Search bar will be automatically removed if you haven't used it for 120 days.{/note}
